item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 19/Aug/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening, the weather will be fine and very hot over southern China early to midweek next week. An upper-air disturbance is expected to bring unsettled weather to the region in the latter part of next week.

Date/Month: 19/08 (Friday)
Wind: East to southeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Sunny intervals and occasional showers. A few thunderstorms later.
Temp range: 26 - 30 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium High
